checks.basis: Five macro MAEs beat TRAIN-angle mean, but BM702 mean illuminance is worse; all room results reported.
Three room groups only; hourly rows not treated as independent rooms or whole-building proof.
K-means representative-room selection and single-building/weather sampling limit transportability.
Predictive scoring only; no adjusted causal coefficients or causal claims.
Zero-label rates and true means retained; BMG26 P10 all zero explicitly discussed.
No model change or improvement attribution between different development/test room sets.
All 52560 scheduled test rows included; no outlier or zero removal.
All five targets, three rooms and four angles reported; no best-test candidate selected.
Many prior development rounds acknowledged; exact frozen model/rules committed before test labels; no post-test parameter changes.
Unseen orientation is a plausible explanation, not proven sole cause.
All model inputs feature-only; predicted P10 uses predicted companion mean; numeric TEST labels loaded after predictions saved.
